whole_value_reasoning: The same Ayacucho-Chanka software guide directly attests the all-object imperative with llapan and the software Delete command wischuy. Removing the repeated Edit menu prefix and substituting the independently attested transitive discard command retains the complete all-object command structure. Soto independently supports intentional discard rather than accidental loss or vomiting. In this actual assembly list, discard/remove all is equivalent to Clear all: it concerns all active entries, not merely placement, selected entries, checkboxes, canvas pixels, or every external file. No final period or completion guarantee is added.

caller_semantics.direct: AssemblyActivity.kt101 invokes assembly.clear through the normal button busy guard and perform exception route.
caller_semantics.active_list: ImageAssembly.kt153 calls change(emptyList()), removing every active AssemblyImage entry, both placed and unplaced. This differs from unplace and single-entry remove.
caller_semantics.transaction_and_history: change validates and writes the new state before recording previous active state in bounded Undo history and clearing redo. Undo and Redo buttons actually invoke assembly.undo/redo at AssemblyActivity79–80. The command does not promise success if write/validation fails.
caller_semantics.pruning_limit: prune retains owned .image files reachable from active state, Undo or Redo and may delete unreachable owned cache files. Current prior entries remain reachable by Undo after clear, but old history may be dropped and redo cleared. This is neither a promise that every file remains forever nor a command to delete external originals. No retention guarantee is added to the translation.
